title: Administrative API Key Constant-Time Verification & Production Fail-Fast
description: The CMP control plane must reject default credentials in production mode and enforce constant-time comparison on admin keys.

title: HMAC-SHA256 Signed Session Token & Cookie Isolation
description: Dashboard authentication must issue tamper-proof HMAC-SHA256 signed session tokens with HttpOnly, SameSite cookie attributes.

title: Wi-Fi 802.11 Association & DHCP Timing Exporter
description: The edge sensor must measure L2 association, 802.1X/WPA authentication, and DHCP lease duration from journal logs.

title: Incident-Triggered RAM Ring Buffer PCAP Capture
description: The edge sensor must maintain a rolling RAM ring buffer and slice bounded 128-byte packet captures on diagnostic incident triggers.

title: Forensic Diagnostic Evidence Bundle Packaging
description: The system must bundle system logs, routing tables, link metrics, and human-readable HTML/Text summaries into a compressed archive.

title: Wi-Fi Radio Resource Management & Dynamic Channel Flap Detection
description: The system must track dynamic channel changes, co-channel interference (CCI), and alert if APs flap >3 times per hour.

title: Lateral East-West Subnet Segmentation Compliance
description: The edge sensor must perform TCP probes against internal management infrastructure to verify isolation of client VLANs.

title: Synthetic Browser & API Transaction Waterfalls
description: The system must execute headless browser synthetic transactions and capture timing metrics for key educational applications.

title: GPS Precision Geolocation & Fallback Profile Resolution
description: The edge sensor must parse NMEA-0183 serial streams from hardware GNSS receivers and fall back to static campus room profiles when indoor.

title: CIPA Internet Safety & Content Filter Policy Compliance
description: The prober must verify whether restricted adult and high-risk threat categories are blocked by the firewall and web proxy.

title: Real-Time UDP Voice & Video Jitter (MOS) Estimation
description: The sensor must compute RFC 3550 interarrival jitter, UDP packet loss, and ITU-T G.107 Mean Opinion Scores for real-time media.

title: Multi-Resolver DNS Benchmark & Failure Detection
description: The sensor must benchmark local DHCP nameservers against public recursive resolvers to detect query latency anomalies and RCODE failures.

title: Scheduled & Throttled iPerf3 Bandwidth Benchmarking
description: The system must execute scheduled throughput benchmarks with bandwidth caps and strict off-peak time window enforcement.

title: WYSIWYG Dynamic Custom Synthetic Probe Execution
description: The sensor must execute dynamically distributed HTTP, TCP, and DNS synthetic test probes with regex payload validation.

title: Interactive & Automated TUI Onboarding Wizard
description: The sensor wizard must execute site surveys, configure Wi-Fi credentials, discover CMP via DHCP Option 43/DNS/mDNS, and register.

title: FAT32 USB Flash Drive Assembly-Line Staging Kit
description: The CMP must generate an in-memory zip archive with bootstrap manifests to support offline mass staging of sensors via USB.

title: Subnet-Based Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP) Auto-Approval
description: The CMP must automatically approve and assign pending sensors based on matched client subnet CIDR ranges.

title: Multi-Campus Hierarchy & District SLA Rollup
description: The CMP must organize sensors into campus hierarchies and compute aggregated SLA and health statistics.

title: Unified Visual Probe Scheduler & Off-Peak Windows
description: The CMP must deliver centralized visual schedules with calendar timing, intervals, and pause/resume toggles to sensors.

title: Instructional Hours Safety Guardrails & Emergency Override
description: The edge reconciler must block active intrusive bandwidth and RF scans during instructional hours unless emergency override is active.

title: Chromebook Fleet Telemetry Ingestion & AP Roaming Trail
description: The CMP must ingest extension telemetry from Chromebooks, track AP roaming transitions, and forward PromQL metrics to TSDB.

title: NOC Wallboard Real-Time Metrics & SaaS Health Feed
description: The CMP must aggregate instant PromQL metrics and SLA statuses for real-time presentation on NOC displays.

title: Database Persistence & Scoped Resource Management
description: The CMP must manage SQLite connections using deterministic context managers with WAL mode and busy timeouts.

title: SNMP Infrastructure & Switch Interface Poller
description: The platform must poll core switches and firewalls via SNMP v2c/v3 to detect bandwidth saturation, memory conserve mode, and interface drops.
